input_file.description: Path to file to read input from. Empty for stdin.

output_dest.description: Destination for output. 'stdout' or a file path.

rate.description: Data rate in bytes/sec with optional suffix (K, M, G, T).

buffer_size.description: Read/write buffer size in bytes with optional suffix. Mutually exclusive with delay.

delay.description: Constant delay in seconds between writes. Mutually exclusive with buffer_size.

delay_mode.description: Delay strategy mode (0-5). Only applies if delay is set.

amount.description: Total amount of data to process with optional suffix (K, M, G, T, P).

shift.description: Tuning shift factor for rate adjustment.

pipe_size.description: Pipe transfer size with optional suffix (K, M, G, T, P).

verbose_freq.description: Verbose statistics update frequency in seconds.

duration.description: Maximum duration to run with optional suffix (s, m, h, d, y).

append.description: Append to output file instead of truncating.

overrun.description: Detect and resize buffer for overruns.

underrun.description: Detect and resize buffer for underruns.

ignore_errors.description: Ignore read errors, replacing with zeros.

flush.description: Flush file output after each write.

stats_eof.description: Print statistics to stderr on EOF.

warn_underrun.description: Warn on long bursts of underrun.

pidfile.description: Path to write PID file. Empty for no PID file.
